packaging_changes: Only the BF16 formal run is agent visible. Earlier qualification runs are excluded.
The paper README, figures, research demos, docs and unused tests are omitted.
Hydra config is renamed and contains the recorded effective overrides; policy math is unchanged.
Checkpoint payloads and derived TensorBoard binaries are omitted; all per-step scalar JSON and optimizer audit records are retained.
The portable launcher performs a normal auto-resumable launch without injecting the historical step-1 resume drill.
Console paths, host labels and ANSI SGR controls are normalized; metric numbers and model text remain unchanged.
Retain exactly three native validation generation records: step 0 row 0, step 200 row 960, step 440 row 1919; all scalar evaluation aggregates remain intact.
Portable launcher and prepare place writable runtime caches and temporary files in the staged workspace; an explicit RAY_TMPDIR may point to a shorter task-owned path.
Environment follows the three-file qwen3vl_geo3k layout: pinned fetching is inline in prepare.sh and source provenance is stored only in hidden issue resources.

The portable prepare and training entrypoints honor an explicit TMPDIR, so long deployment paths can use a short task-owned socket directory. This fixes packaging-only tensor IPC startup, without changing the recorded policy computation.
